_note: Bowlers the warehouse cannot classify with one style+hand code. The feed stamps every delivery with the player's registered style and hand, so a bowler who switches arms is stamped with only one of them. Their balls are still spin (or pace), so they stay in the macro group and only drop out of the exact-type reels and profiles, where they would otherwise show the wrong bowler entirely. Add an id here when footage disagrees with the coded type. Verified by watching the vision, not by another data source — the Players table and the Deliveries rows come from the same feed and agree with each other.

per_ball._note: Spinners who bowl off spin and leg spin with one arm. Every other ball of theirs (carrom ball, arm ball, quicker ball, uncoded) drops out of the exact types and stays in the macro spin group.
